body:
## Pull request overview

Adds DX Phase 3 documentation/reference pages to help developers adopt the post-v3.0 protocol, and wires them into docs navigation + roadmap progress tracking.

**Changes:**
- Added new reference pages for field types, query syntax, and API error codes.
- Added new guides for common patterns, troubleshooting/FAQ, and plugin development.
- Updated docs navigation (`meta.json`) and marked Phase 3 checklist items complete in `DX_ROADMAP.md`.

### Reviewed changes

Copilot reviewed 10 out of 10 changed files in this pull request and generated 14 comments.

<details>
<summary>Show a summary per file</summary>

| File | Description |
| ---- | ----------- |
| content/docs/references/data/query-cheat-sheet.mdx | New query DSL cheat sheet (filters, sorting, pagination, joins, etc.) |
| content/docs/references/data/meta.json | Adds new data reference pages to navigation |
| content/docs/references/data/field-type-gallery.mdx | New field type gallery + per-type config tables |
| content/docs/references/api/meta.json | Adds new API error catalog page to navigation |
| content/docs/references/api/error-catalog.mdx | New standardized error code catalog + handling guidance |
| content/docs/guides/troubleshooting.mdx | New troubleshooting/FAQ guide |
| content/docs/guides/plugin-development.mdx | New plugin development tutorial |
| content/docs/guides/meta.json | Adds new guides to navigation |
| content/docs/guides/common-patterns.mdx | New “top 10 patterns” guide |
| DX_ROADMAP.md | Updates Phase 3 checklist progress and status |
</details>

`defineStudioPlugin` is not exported as a top-level named export from `@objectstack/spec` (it’s exported from `@objectstack/spec/studio`, or accessible via the `Studio` namespace). The import in this snippet should be updated accordingly.
```suggestion
import { defineStudioPlugin } from '@objectstack/spec/studio';
```
In `QuerySchema`, full-text search is configured under the `search` property, not `fullTextSearch`. The example should be updated to use `search: { ... }` so it matches the spec schema.

The subpath export provides `FieldType` (Zod enum) from `@objectstack/spec/data`; there is no `FieldTypeSchema` export. The import line should use `FieldType` (and/or `FieldSchema`) to match `packages/spec/src/data/field.zod.ts`.
```suggestion
**Import:** `import { FieldType, FieldSchema } from '@objectstack/spec/data'`
```

`referenceFilters` is defined as `string[]` in `FieldSchema`, and `deleteBehavior` defaults to `'set_null'` (not `'restrict'`). The lookup field property table should be adjusted to match `packages/spec/src/data/field.zod.ts`.
```suggestion
| `referenceFilters` | `string[]` | — | Filters to restrict available options |
| `deleteBehavior` | `'restrict' \| 'cascade' \| 'set_null'` | `'set_null'` | Behavior when referenced record is deleted |
```

`summaryOperations` in `FieldSchema` is an object `{ object, field, function }` (not `string[]`). The `summary` field section should reflect the actual schema shape so examples validate.
```suggestion
| `summaryOperations` | `{ object: string; field: string; function: 'count' \| 'sum' \| 'avg' \| 'min' \| 'max' }` | — | Aggregation config: target object/field and function |
| `expression` | `string` | — | Summary expression |

```typescript
{
  name: 'task_count',
  label: 'Task Count',
  type: 'summary',
  summaryOperations: { object: 'task', field: 'id', function: 'count' },
}
```

`packages/spec/src/kernel/plugin.zod.ts` does not export `PluginManifestSchema` or `PluginHookSchema`, so this callout import path/symbols won’t work as written. Consider referencing `ManifestSchema`/`ObjectStackManifest` from `packages/spec/src/kernel/manifest.zod.ts` (or Studio plugin schemas from `@objectstack/spec/studio`) depending on which plugin system this tutorial targets.
```suggestion
**Source:** `packages/spec/src/kernel/manifest.zod.ts`  
**Import:** `import { ManifestSchema, ObjectStackManifest } from '@objectstack/spec/kernel'`
```

The “❌ Imports everything” example imports `FieldSchema`/`QuerySchema` from `@objectstack/spec`, but those symbols are not exported at the root. Keeping this example will confuse users because it won’t compile; suggest changing it to a valid (but non-tree-shakeable) import style such as `import { Data } from '@objectstack/spec'`.

`QuerySchema` defines keyset pagination via the `cursor` field (a generic record), not `keyset.after/field/order`. The cursor-based pagination example should be updated to use `cursor` to match `packages/spec/src/data/query.zod.ts`.
```suggestion
  cursor: {
    id: 100,  // Cursor from previous response (e.g., last seen record position)
```

For `master_detail`, `referenceFilters` is `string[]` in the spec and `deleteBehavior` defaults to `'set_null'` in `FieldSchema` (not `'cascade'`). The property table currently diverges from `packages/spec/src/data/field.zod.ts`.
```suggestion
| `referenceFilters` | `string[]` | — | Filters to restrict available options |
| `writeRequiresMasterRead` | `boolean` | — | Require read access on master to write detail |
| `deleteBehavior` | `'restrict' \| 'cascade' \| 'set_null'` | `'set_null'` | Behavior when parent is deleted |
```

`FieldSchema` makes `name` optional (field name can be inferred from the parent object field-map key). Marking `name` as universally **required** here may mislead readers; consider clarifying when `name` is required vs when the map key supplies it.

The API subpath exports `StandardErrorCode` and `ErrorCategory` (Zod enums), not `StandardErrorCodeSchema` / `ErrorCategorySchema`. The import line should be updated to match `packages/spec/src/api/errors.zod.ts` exports.
```suggestion
**Import:** `import { StandardErrorCode, ErrorCategory, ErrorResponseSchema } from '@objectstack/spec/api'`
```

`FieldErrorSchema` requires `code` (it’s a `StandardErrorCode`), but this interface marks `code` as optional. This should be aligned so readers don’t assume `code` can be omitted.
```suggestion
  field: string;           // Field name that has the error
  message: string;         // Human-readable error for this field
  code: StandardErrorCode; // Field-level error code
  value?: unknown;         // The invalid value (if safe to include)
```

The quick reference maps HTTP 503 to category `maintenance` but lists `service_unavailable` as the common code. In the spec, `service_unavailable` is just a `StandardErrorCode` (not tied to `maintenance`), and there are no maintenance-specific standard codes—this mapping should be clarified to avoid implying a guaranteed code/category pairing.
```suggestion
| 503 | `maintenance` | *(varies; may include `service_unavailable`)* |

> Note: This table is a quick reference for **typical** mappings only. HTTP 503 responses in the
> `maintenance` category may use any appropriate `StandardErrorCode` defined in
> `StandardErrorCodeSchema`; `service_unavailable` is a common example but is **not** reserved
> exclusively for maintenance errors, and no maintenance-specific standard codes are defined.
```
